items.description: Emirates NBD launched new co-branded cards in partnership with Emaar, Aldar, Majid Al Futtaim and Amazon to enhance its retail card offering.

items.description: Emirates NBD partnered with coworking platform Letswork to run a 12‑month pilot giving selected bank employees on‑demand access to 4,000+ desks, meeting rooms, and offices across the UAE and abroad, with potential expansion.

items.description: Emirates NBD signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Fidelity International to co-develop a workplace savings proposition for UAE employers, combining Emirates NBD’s local banking and asset management capabilities with Fidelity’s global retirement and investment expertise.
